name: Gauge fields
description: How the forces work: photons, gluons, and W and Z bosons.

name: Matter
description: How quarks and leptons move and feel the forces.

name: Hermitian conjugate
description: The same again, the other way round. Physicists love writing it.

name: Yukawa couplings
description: How quarks and leptons get their masses from the Higgs field.

name: Another hermitian conjugate
description: Yes, again.

name: Higgs field
description: How the Higgs field moves, and how the W and Z bosons get heavy.

name: Higgs potential
description: The Mexican hat. With this, the Standard Model is complete.

name: Neutrino masses
description: Right-handed neutrinos, to give neutrinos their tiny masses.

name: Theta term
description: It could break CP symmetry in the strong force. Nobody knows why it is so small.

name: Axion
description: A new field that would explain why. It could be the dark matter, too.

name: Dark matter
description: A particle for the dark matter: heavy, shy and still missing.

name: Gravity
description: Einstein's general relativity, in one term.

name: Cosmological constant
description: The smallest term with the biggest effect: the universe expands faster and faster.

name: Inflaton
description: The field that blew up the early universe.

name: Supersymmetry
description: A superpartner for every particle.

name: Extra dimensions
description: Heavier copies of every particle, from dimensions curled up too small to see.

name: String theory
description: Every particle is a tiny vibrating string.

name: Quantum gravity
description: Add up every possible shape of spacetime.

name: The multiverse
description: One Lagrangian for every universe in the string landscape.

name: The next discovery
description: Whatever we find next. Physics is never finished.
